{{Quote|Thus we triumph! I invoke the Path of Blood!''"<br />"''I will remember you Mistress!''"<br />"''No. You won't.|The First Witch of the Wyrd and her second-in-command, as the First Witch slew her assistant to call upon the Path of Blood|<ref name="APOD" />}}
The '''Path of Blood''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based rite derived from the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] that was capable of [[Death/Legends|killing]] a [[ch'hala tree]]. The Path of Blood was among teachings derived from ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] practices that were shared with the [[Wyrd]], a [[Coven/Legends|Coven]] of [[Tarasin]] Force [[Witch/Legends|witches]], by the leader of the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]], [[Len Markus]].<ref name="APOD" />

Circa [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="19 BBY">''[[Heart of Evil: A Plague of Darkness]]'' is set shortly before ''[[Heart of Evil: A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance]]'', a [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] adventure that occurs concurrently with the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. As the battle is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the events of ''A Plague of Darkness'' can be placed in circa 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the [[First Witch of the Wyrd]] invoked the Path of Blood in order to kill the [[Heart Tree|World Tree Ch'hala]] following the failure of an attempt to turn the ch'hala to the dark side of the Force. The First Witch called upon the Path of Blood by stabbing and killing her [[Unidentified Wyrd second-in-command|second-in-command]] with a [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long, [[Color/Legends|black]] metallic rod, which triggered an intense, red-colored energy wave that discharged into the ch'hala. However, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] sacrificed himself and merged his consciousness into the ch'hala to enable it to fight off the dark power unleashed by the Path of Blood. The energy released by the rite was then deflected out from the tree and onto the First Witch, causing her to explode.<ref name="APOD" />
